question: What is the difference between the total surface area and the curved area of a hemisphere having a diameter of 14 cm? (Use π = (22)/(7))
solution:
**Given:**

Diameter of hemisphere = 14 cm

Radius of hemisphere (r) = Diameter/2 = 7 cm

pi = (22)/(7)

**Formula used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a hemisphere = 3pi r²

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a hemisphere = 2pi r²

Difference = TSA - CSA

**Calculation:**

Total Surface Area = 3pi r²

⇒ TSA = 3 × (22)/(7) × 7²

⇒ TSA = 3 × (22)/(7) × 49

⇒ TSA = 3 × 154 = 462 cm²

Curved Surface Area = 2pi r²

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22)/(7) × 7²

⇒ CSA = 2 × (22)/(7) × 49

⇒ CSA = 2 × 154 = 308 cm²

Difference = TSA - CSA

⇒ Difference = 462 - 308

⇒ Difference = 154 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Difference = TSA - CSA

⇒ Difference = 3pi r² - 2pi r²

⇒ Difference = pi r²

pi = (22)/(7)

⇒ Difference = 22/7 × 7²

**Difference = 22/7 × 49 = 154 cm2**

3b
